definitions.meaning: Absence of good will, dislike, despite, repugnance, reluctance; the genitive, with adverbial force, against one's will, not willingly, without one's consent, without intention, involuntarily, is (almost) the only case used.

quotations.citations: L. Ecg. P. ii. 1; Th. ii. 182, 13

quotations.old_english: Unwilles wé magon forleósan ða hwílwendlícan gód, ac wé ne forleósaþ nǽfre unwilles ða écan gód
Gif ðú mé unwilles gewemman dést
Hé ðǽr wunode ða niht unwilles, se ðe sylfwilles nolde
quotations.citations: Homl. Th. ii. 184, 13: L. Eth. vi. 52; Th. i. 328, 21

quotations.old_english: Þeáh ðú mé geoffrige mínes unwilles, ic beó þeáh unscyldig

quotations.citations: L. Ecg. P. ii. 15, tit.; Th. ii, 180, 27

quotations.old_english: Heó wæs hire unwilles fram him

source_text: un-wil[l], es; n, Absence of good will, dislike, despite, repugnance, reluctance; the genitive, with adverbial force, against one's will, not willingly, without one's consent, without intention, involuntarily, is (almost) the only case used. (1) alone :-- Gif hé hit dide unwilles si praeter voluntatem id fecerit, L. Ecg. P. ii. 1; Th. ii. 182, 13. Unwilles wé magon forleósan ða hwílwendlícan gód, ac wé ne forleósaþ nǽfre unwilles ða écan gód, Homl. Th. i. 576, 7-9: Hexam. 17; Norm. 26, 3. Gif ðú mé unwilles gewemman dést, Homl. Skt. i. 9, 90. Hé ðǽr wunode ða niht unwilles, se ðe sylfwilles nolde, Homl. Th. ii. 184, 13: L. Eth. vi. 52; Th. i. 328, 21. (2) with pronouns :-- Þeáh ðú mé geoffrige mínes unwilles, ic beó þeáh unscyldig, Homl. Skt. i. 9, 87. Hire unwilles invita ipsa, L. Ecg. P. ii. 15, tit.; Th. ii, 180, 27. Heó wæs hire unwilles fram him ab eo invita aberat, 15; Th. ii. 186, 29. Heora unwilles, L. Edg. S. 2; Th, i. 274, 5. [Ich mot nede, ant neoðeles min unwil hit is to don al þ-bar; ti wil is, Marh. 13, 3. Ha wes him ihondsald þah hit hire unwil were, Jul. 7, 12. Heo wes ihondsald al hire unwilles, 6, 5.] v. next word.
